description: Ground truth for grading live-eval verdicts against the seeded baselines. Each entry quotes the vendor's own page. Review states: 'provisional' (not yet re-opened), 'agent-verified YYYY-MM-DD' (an AI agent opened the page and found the quoted text), 'human-confirmed' (a person opened and checked it). Grades are reported as PROVISIONAL unless every graded entry is 'human-confirmed'. Entries whose price was not visible have no 'expected' and are not graded (never guess). Expectations change only when official evidence justifies it, never to make the system pass; every change is logged in 'changeLog'.

methods.page-fetch: automated fetch of the official page text (no JavaScript rendering)
methods.official-domain-search: official-domain search excerpt (Tavily include_domains), independent of the system's LLM extraction
